title: Robot uccide 9 umani
note: Reputable Italian tech news outlet. Article in Italian reporting the 2007 South Africa incident: a computer-controlled 35mm anti-aircraft cannon (Oerlikon) malfunctioned during a live-fire exercise, killing 9 soldiers and wounding 14 after emptying its 250 rounds out of control. Matches the case exactly (9 dead, 14 wounded, South Africa, 2007, anti-aircraft gun).
